## What changes

One line under ADR-0141 › Open items › 4 (*A disabled dependency*), recording the maintainer's ruling on #30379
(record 6670643454, letter A, item 4): an enabled dependent (a rule that reads a field X adds) refuses the disable.

## Why

Ruling A item 4 asks for exactly this line. The runtime half of the same ruling (the package disable door refusing with
`409` while an enabled package's validation rule reads a field the package adds through `objectExtensions`) ships in a
separate code PR from this branch after this one, once its ledgered error code lands. The two are never bundled.

## Tests

None: a docs-only change to one ADR line. No code, schema, generated artifact or published file moves.

- The line is appended to item 4's paragraph, so it renders as that item's last sentence; the item's measurement text
  above it is kept as written.
